body.name: Robust feasible proxy sets
body.construction: \(\mathcal J_B(\mathfrak G)=\{J\subseteq W:\sum_{w\in J}c(w)\le B\text{ and, for every }h\in\mathbb B^R,\ \theta_t(y)\text{ is identifiable from }\mathcal I_{h,J}\text{ over }\mathcal P_{+,h}(G_h,J)\}\), where acquisition precedes release of the logged configuration record.
